subject.title: [Bug]: Ctrl+C not working in Windows install on foreground

question: Should this issue wait for native Windows npm-global Ctrl+C reproduction before a new repair PR is queued?
rationale: The source path already handles delivered SIGINT, so a fix location cannot be chosen safely without proving whether the failure is signal delivery through Windows shells/npm shims or shutdown after delivery.

options.title: Require Windows live repro
options.body: Keep this issue open for a Windows-capable maintainer or reporter to validate current main or the latest package in PowerShell, cmd.exe, and Windows Terminal before repair work starts.

options.title: Queue after signal-delivery proof
options.body: If live proof confirms Ctrl+C is not delivered to the foreground process, queue a narrow run-loop or wrapper fix with cleanup tests and Windows package proof.

recommendation.title: Require Windows live repro
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a Windows-capable maintainer or reporter to validate current main or the latest package in PowerShell, cmd.exe, and Windows Terminal before repair work starts.

likelyOwner.reason: History points to repeated gateway CLI lifecycle work and docs ownership near the affected foreground command path.
